resource_purpose_map.WTC: coverage-exempt FRQ decomposition/navigation practice around one coherent shared stimulus
resource_purpose_map.Example_YTI: Example models a thinking/application pathway; YTI is its deliberate parallel application
resource_purpose_map.Practice: rich instructional and downstream source pool; PS1 seeds 10 vocabulary + 10 conceptual + 4 Physics math, with PS2/PS3/Extra controlled parallels
resource_purpose_map.CYU: concise current-section check adapted from strong Practice families, not secure evidence
resource_purpose_map.Warm_Up: predictable retrieval/bridge routine with Q1 recent, Q2 older/spiraled, Q3 conceptual/vocabulary/application, Q4 recurring Physics math
resource_purpose_map.Exit_Ticket: four unique secure seed evidence jobs on A; B/C parallel the same four families with fresh secure instances
resource_purpose_map.Summative: 20-slot secure Unit mastery evidence; V1 master blueprint, V2-V4 parallels, V5 alternate blueprint, V6 parallel of V5

i_can_map.learning_target: Students will explain how physics uses observation, measurement, evidence, models, and testable claims to understand the natural world.
i_can_map.exact_i_can: I can distinguish between an observation, inference, hypothesis, law, and theory.
i_can_map.evidence_job: distinguish observation from inference and related scientific knowledge claims using what was actually observed or measured
likely_misconceptions: Treating an inference as an observation
assuming an explanation is scientific because it sounds plausible
treating a formula as a rule with no physical meaning
i_can_map.notes_anchor_plan: At least one complete Example/YTI pair directly mapped to this exact I-can; representation-explicit targets use the actual representation.
i_can_map.secure_assessment_plan: Directly sampled on every Exit form for its section and every Summative form; secure stimuli remain independent from exposed instructional instances.
formula_relationships_or_na: measurement relationships as meaning-bearing models; no required computation formula
tool_opportunities: measurement/data table or simple model when it carries evidence
